POST_MIGRATION_LOCATION.ruling: R1 outside-layout adjudication: bounded forward migration of R1/tools and R1/packets into the allowlisted R1/receipts, without deleting material.
POST_MIGRATION_LOCATION.whyFlat: The move was FLAT, not into a receipts/tools/ subfolder. R1/receipts sits at the IDENTICAL depth to the old R1/tools, so every instrument's fixed path.resolve(HERE, '..', ...) walk still resolves to packages/core with no edit. A nested move would have added one level and forced an edit to overlay-causality-probe.mjs, which is FROZEN — that would have destroyed its FINAL_SHA.
POST_MIGRATION_LOCATION.attestedValuesAboveAreUNMODIFIED: The path and sha256 values recorded above are the machine's original self-attestation and have deliberately NOT been rewritten. Rewriting a self-attestation by hand would stop it being one. This block records the current location alongside it so no reference dangles.
